# Alpine Ride — reconstructed snowboard shopping assets

This package reconstructs a three-phone snowboard e-commerce screenshot of **1448 × 1086 px**. No original source imagery was supplied. Art is **not claimed to be original**.

**Important limitation:** The two AI-generated reference sheets used as intermediate reconstruction material were segmented into individual output files. Individual product images were not each generated by a separate generative invocation. The source was not a layered export, so unseen regions and several color variants are estimates.

Images contain no UI prices, buttons, text, cards or platform status indicators. UI controls are independent SVGs and style guidance.

## Geometry / layering

Left screen approx `x=56..489, y=78..1010`, center `517..935`, right `962..1396`. Background and shadows are CSS. All these pixel measurements are visual raster estimates, **not recovered design tokens**.

- Left: full-bleed hero photo behind headline, navigation, vertical category chips and foreground gradient/wave popular strip; Alpine Pro first circle, Fire board second, White Blue third.
- Middle: category selector and catalog are normal CSS UI; product cutouts are not flattened into tile gradients. Use same boot, helmet and goggles in categories, and do not duplicate media files.
- Right: top hero photograph placed behind back/favorite/slides; bottom white sheet hides photo via its rounded top; related product thumbnails reuse original card assets.
- Product image alpha includes minimal immediate anti-aliasing/contact shadow; do not add a second strong contact shadow. CSS card shadows affect card only.
- No status-bar icons produced.

Native tall 0.46 aspect.
